properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 7 at 6:07PM MDT until September 7 at 6:30PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 607 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Shamrock, or 23
miles south of Fort Morgan, moving northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Twelve-Mile Corner and Shamrock.
properties.areaDesc: Adams, CO; Morgan, CO; Washington, CO

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 7 at 5:46PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 546 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 8
miles south of Timpas, or 24 miles southwest of La Junta, moving
northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Timpas.
properties.areaDesc: La Junta Vicinity/Otero County; Eastern Las Animas County

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 7 at 5:26PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 526 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 6
miles southeast of Leader, or 29 miles south of Fort Morgan, moving
northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Shamrock, Adena, Twelve-Mile Corner and Leader.
